response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a talented, versatile software engineer with deep experience in web, backend, and systems programming, but his profile does not match this role's core requirements. He has minimal recent C++ experience (a brief stint in 2014-2015), no Windows platform focus, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a fintech-adjacent role at RIDE Capital using JavaScript/TypeScript, not C++.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering background with 15+ years of experience
Demonstrated adaptability across many languages, platforms, and domains
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (under 1 year, nearly a decade ago) and not on Windows platform
No SQL Server or Oracle experience listed; only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain expertise

key_factors.factor: No fixed income / capital markets domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform expertise
